name: SmolLM3-3B
notes: Trained with the smoltalk2 mixture (HuggingFaceTB's 2025 SFT dataset); config declares layer_types all full_attention, so no sliding-window or hybrid mix. The unusual serving-relevant detail is positional: no_rope_layer_interval 4 with no_rope_layers showing 1 on three of every four layers, i.e. 27 of 36 layers carry no rotary embedding at all (NoPE) and only 9 are RoPE'd. Kernel selection cannot assume uniform RoPE across layers. rope_theta 5000000, no rope_scaling, 65536 native context. tie_word_embeddings true at vocab 128256 keeps the parameter count low for the context length. head_dim derived as 2048 / 16 = 128; gqa_ratio = 16 / 4 = 4.KV bytes/token at bf16 (2 bytes/element): 36 layers x 4 KV heads x 128 head_dim x 2 (K and V) x 2 bytes = 73728 B/token = 72.0 KiB/token. At 64k context that is 4.50 GiB of KV per sequence at bf16 - still 1.5x the model's own 6.15 GB bf16 weight footprint.
